allow: Merged Git cleanup: Allow removing clean, inactive worktrees and deleting local and configured-remote feature branches in the working repository after verifying the associated PR is merged and the branch has no work outside that merge. Allow git branch -D for verified squash/rebase merges. Remote branch deletion is allowed when the user or repository rules request post-merge remote cleanup. This does not allow deleting default, shared or release branches, discarding uncommitted work, or force-pushing.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh api[^|;&]*(comments|reviews)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(-X|--method)[ =]+(POST|PATCH|PUT|DELETE)|(^| )(-f|-F|--field|--raw-field|--input)[ =]' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Mutating gh api comment/review call — confirm to proceed"}}' || true
